name: Souma Ayaka
source:
The elder sister of Kurea Souma, the heroine who appears in the previous work "Shinsei Kourin Dacryon ~Tadashii Tenshi no Sodatekata~".
Her personality is somewhat unusual, she's calm and carefree but her ideas can be a bit bizzarre.
One day she obtained the "angel maker" at the same time as Erika and blew up as "Dacryon Ayaka".
She lives with her mother. She cares about her little sister.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015249.html/]DLsite[/url]]
